text: Is the patient awake and responding normally, and are they experiencing any severe chest pain, trouble breathing, or heavy bleeding right now?
Yes, he is awake and talking. No, he isn't having chest pain, trouble breathing, or heavy bleeding.
Can you tell me what happened, when it started, and how bad the pain is on a scale of 0 to 10?
He fell down 4 steps at home an hour ago and landed on his right hip. He can't stand and his pain is a 7/10.
At any point today, did you notice his face drooping, his arm becoming weak or numb, or his speech sounding slurred or strange?
No, I didn't notice any of those things.
Are his fingers or toes numb, cold, or turning blue, and can he still move them?
I'm not sure, I haven't checked his fingers or toes yet.
Roughly how far did he fall?
He fell down 4 steps.
Did he lose consciousness or hit his head at any point?
No, there was no head strike and no blackout.
Does he take any regular medications?
Yes, he takes a blood pressure pill and a small pill to thin his blood.

writes: small pill to thin his blood

text: Could you please check the box and tell me the exact name of the blood thinner for the doctors?
It is warfarin.

sources: CDC Field Triage Guidelines (MMWR 2012), Step Four special considerations: anticoagulation / bleeding disorders (sources/CDC-Field-Triage-2011-MMWR.pdf)
NICE NG232 (2023), rec 1.5.9: CT for head injury with current anticoagulant treatment (sources/NICE-NG232-main-guideline.pdf)

text: Does he have any allergies to medication or other medical conditions, such as heart problems, diabetes, or any issues affecting his immune system?
He is allergic to penicillin, which gives him a rash. He also has high blood pressure and an irregular heartbeat.
Is he currently pregnant or postpartum, or does he have any conditions that affect his immune system?
He has an irregular heartbeat and high blood pressure.

Has he had a fever, any rashes, traveled overseas in the last two weeks, or been in contact with anyone who is sick?
